title: CGIAR Climate Data Hub — Climate Asset entry
description: Schema for a single 'new & notable' climate data asset, tool, atlas, model, publication or method, as surfaced in the CDH assets newsfeed/dashboard.

id.description: Stable kebab-case slug, unique across the catalogue. Used as the anchor/permalink and as the key for comments and ratings.

type.description: The kind of resource. dataset = downloadable data; atlas-hub = interactive portal/platform; tool-software = code, library, app; model = ML/foundation/emulator model; publication = paper/report/preprint; media = slides/video/blog; contact = a person/lead worth knowing.

url.description: Primary link. May be empty string if none yet (set access to 'unknown' and note it).

themes.description: TOPIC facet: the subject the asset is about. 1-2 per entry, primary (best-fit) first. Not a format or approach label — those live in 'type' and 'tags'.

tags.description: Free-form lowercase-kebab keywords for search and cross-cutting facets (approach, region, technique, commodity), e.g. 'ai', 'remote-sensing', 'earth-engine', 'downscaling', 'africa', 'livestock', 'open-data'.

source.description: Publisher or hosting organisation (e.g. 'Nature Scientific Data', 'GitHub — openlandmap', 'WFP', 'World Bank').

description.description: 1–2 factual sentences: what it is and why it is useful for climate/agriculture data work.

region.description: Geographic focus, e.g. 'Global', 'Africa', 'Vietnam'. Empty if not applicable/unclear.

spatial_resolution.description: For datasets: native grid/resolution if stated (e.g. '~250 m', '0.1 deg'). Empty otherwise.

temporal_coverage.description: For datasets: time span / cadence if stated (e.g. '1961–1990 normals', 'daily 1979–present'). Empty otherwise.

access.description: How obtainable the resource is. open = freely accessible; login = needs an account/SSO; paywall = subscription/purchase; request = available on request; unknown = not yet confirmed.

collection.description: Which source list the entry came from: 'assets' (datasets/atlases doc) or 'methods' (methods doc).

section.description: Original heading it was filed under in the source doc (free text; kept for provenance).

shared_by.description: Person/team who suggested it, where known.

notes.description: Free-text: caveats, cross-listing, alt access routes, contacts, credentials, TBCs.

date_added.description: ISO date the item was added to the feed (drives 'newest first' in newsfeed view). 'TBC' where unknown.

date.description: Publication/release date of the asset itself (YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD), used for 'newest first' sorting in the feed. Distinct from date_added (when it entered the Hub feed). Empty if unknown.

image.description: URL of a preview/thumbnail image (typically the asset's og:image). Empty if none; the UI falls back to a themed banner.

links.description: Additional key resources beyond the primary url, e.g. data mirror, paper, code, demo.

organisations.description: Institutions/organisations behind the asset (authors' affiliations, hosting body, developer).

licence.description: Content/data licence, normalised (e.g. 'CC-BY-4.0','CC0-1.0','MIT','proprietary'). Empty if not determined.

data_availability.description: For publications especially: whether underlying data/code is available, e.g. 'Open data', 'Open (with code)', 'Code only', 'On request', 'No associated data'.

reusable.description: True when the data is openly available under a permissive/attribution licence (CC0, CC-BY, CC-BY-SA, MIT, BSD, Apache, GPL/LGPL/AGPL, ODbL, Etalab-2.0, OGL, public domain) and could therefore be reused/ingested in the Hub. NC, ND, proprietary, unknown or mixed-source terms are false. Copyleft is true but carries share-alike obligations (AGPL extends them to network use) - record those in notes.

ongoing.description: True for living/continuously-updated resources (portals, dashboards, live datasets, recurring reports) rather than a one-off dated publication. Drives the 'Ongoing / continuous' filter bucket and badge.

lead_contact.description: Lead/corresponding author or maintainer. All sub-fields optional; empty where unknown. Emails only if publicly published (e.g. corresponding-author email).

rating.description: OPTIONAL aggregate rating, populated by the backend once ratings are live. Not part of the static seed data.
